mapper.sql: id, team_id, applicant_id, message, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_application (team_id, applicant_id, message, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{applicantId}, #{message}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM team_application WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND applicant_id = #{applicantId}
SELECT FROM team_application WHERE team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT a.*, t.title as team_title FROM team_application a LEFT JOIN team t ON a.team_id = t.id WHERE a.applicant_id = #{applicantId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE team_application SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_application WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND status = #{status}
SELECT user_id FROM team WHERE id = #{teamId}
SELECT id, username, avatar FROM user WHERE id IN #{uid}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_application WHERE status=#{status}
